modeling_role: Defines the categories or conditions represented by the state space
review_requirement: Document whether states represent condition risk behavior status regime location health compliance or process stage
responsible_use_warning: State labels can hide severity heterogeneity overlapping conditions and measurement error

modeling_role: Defines what movement from one state to another means
review_requirement: State whether transitions are observed frequencies probabilities policy rules simulations expert judgments or scenario assumptions
responsible_use_warning: Transition probabilities should not be treated as causal mechanisms without evidence

modeling_role: Defines the period represented by one transition
review_requirement: Document whether one step represents a day week month year event decision cycle or operational interval
responsible_use_warning: Transition probabilities lose meaning without a clear time scale

modeling_role: Verifies that transition probabilities are valid
review_requirement: Check nonnegative probabilities row or column sums and matrix orientation
responsible_use_warning: Invalid stochastic structure can make all downstream results meaningless

modeling_role: Defines whether current state is treated as sufficient for future movement
review_requirement: Review whether history cumulative exposure repeated disruption policy intervention or hidden subgroups affect transitions
responsible_use_warning: A memoryless model may distort systems where history matters

modeling_role: Defines how long-run distributions should be communicated
review_requirement: Check convergence reducibility periodicity and stability of transition probabilities
responsible_use_warning: Stationary distributions describe the model not guaranteed real-world destiny

modeling_role: Tests whether outputs are robust to transition uncertainty and scenario changes
review_requirement: Compare baseline stress intervention time-varying and uncertainty-perturbed transition matrices
responsible_use_warning: Small transition-probability changes can accumulate into large long-run differences

modeling_role: Defines what the Markov model can and cannot support
review_requirement: Attach interpretation limits uncertainty notes validation status and stop-use conditions to outputs
responsible_use_warning: State transition models should support accountable judgment not replace domain review
